goal: Customers are reporting that once our rate limiter blocks them, they stay blocked for hours — see logs/support-2026-09-19.txt. Figure out why. Don't change any files yet; just investigate and tell me what you find.
prompts: Thanks. Here's what the fix has to respect. The limit itself stays 100 requests per 60 seconds. Limit per API key (the x-api-key header), and only fall back to the client IP when a request has no key: the mobile customers share carrier NAT IPs. A blocked request gets a 429 with a Retry-After header: whole seconds until the window resets, rounded up, and never 0. Don't change config/limits.json, the ops dashboard parses it. With that in mind, look at what else reads the limiter or the config. Still no edits.

One more thing from support: the internal health checker sends x-internal-health: 1 and must never be rate limited. Everything else stays as I said. Go through test/ and tell me which tests would need to change, then summarize the fix you plan to make. Still no edits.
Go ahead and implement the fix now, then run the tests.
